caseNameFull: KATZ Et Al. v. SINGERMAN Et Al.
attorneys: G. Wray Gill and Gerard H. Schreiber for appellants., Robert Weinstein and Herman L. Midlo for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
